Pieces ordered: 4 pieces of 3.20 m, 8 pieces of 3.00 m, 4 pieces of 2.70 m, 13 pieces of 2.55 m, 17 pieces of 2.00 m, 7 pieces of 1.15 m, 9 pieces of 1.05 m, 9 pieces of 1.00 m.
What is the minimum number of 6-metre bars needed to cut the whole order?
